summary: Matter Reference feature tested. Backend: 22/22 new tests passed (tests/test_matter_reference.py). They cover the CSV matter_ref column and all 8 aliases, whitespace collapse, the 60-char limit, blank -> null, the template header, flagged-row fix with matter_ref, PUT /merchants/{mid}/stops/{sid}/matter (own store/admin 200, other store 403, anon 401, another store's stop 404, clear with blank or null), receipts list matter_ref, the PDF 'Matter / file no.' row (checked with pypdf text extraction), and ZIP filenames with the sanitized ref. Regression test_receipt_archive_linkpages.py: 35/35 pass after updating its exact-key assertion for the new matter_ref field. Receipt email: the send was attempted and hit a Resend 429 (external rate limit); the subject and body were only checked by code review. Frontend (375x667, mer-1 temporarily set to law_office): the matter button, autofocus, typing, Enter or SAVE, the 'MATTER X SAVED' toast, the 'MATTER X ✎' label, clearing ('MATTER REMOVED'), cancel ✕, tapping the matter button (does not navigate), the CSV help text, the receipts card 'MATTER X · date' and search by matter all work. There are 2 UI bugs: (1) tapping the matter TextInput or the gap around SAVE navigates to /customer/{code}, because the editor sits inside the order-row Pressable; (2) the Signed Receipts card is stale after tagging a delivered order. Non-law store: no matter buttons, no matter_ref in the help text. mer-1 restored to {business_type:'store', signature_required:false}; TEST/TSMR stops and new import jobs cleaned up.

minor.issue: Provider returned 429 rate_limited during the test, so receipt_email_status='failed'. This is external. The subject/body matter text was verified only by code review (receipts.py:95,101).

ui_bugs.issue: While editing, tapping (clicking) the matter TextInput or any empty space in the editor row (e.g. 4px left of SAVE) fires the outer row Pressable's onPress -> router.push('/customer/{code}'). The user leaves the portal and loses the edit. Reproduced: tap matter-edit -> tap matter-input -> URL becomes /customer/TSMRADE31. The matter-edit button, SAVE and ✕ themselves do not navigate. Fix: wrap the editing <View style={s.row}> (and ideally the whole MatterTag) in a View with onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true} (plus onTouchEnd/onClick e.stopPropagation on web), or move MatterTag out of the row Pressable. Reference: frontend/app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:232-249, frontend/src/components/MatterTag.tsx:39-46

After tagging or re-tagging a delivered (signed) order, the row shows 'MATTER LIT-88 ✎' but the Signed Receipts card still shows the old 'MATTER LIT-77' until the page reloads. MatterTag onSaved only calls q.refetch() for ['merchant', id]. Fix: also invalidate queryKey ['receipts', merchantId] (useQueryClient().invalidateQueries) in onSaved. Reference: frontend/app/merchant/[merchantId].tsx:249, frontend/src/components/ReceiptArchive.tsx:16

issues: The 'MATTER / FILE NO. (OPTIONAL)' field shows for every store type, including bakeries and pharmacies, but the CSV help and the row button are law-office only. Consider gating it on business_type === 'law_office' (FixRowSheet.tsx:24).

action_items: HIGH: Stop tap propagation from the MatterTag editor to the order-row Pressable. Tapping matter-input-{id} or the gaps in the editor row currently navigates to /customer/{code}.
MEDIUM: After a matter save, also invalidate the ['receipts', merchantId] query so the Signed Receipts card shows the new matter immediately.
LOW: Gate the matter field in FixRowSheet to law_office stores.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: clean_matter is applied consistently (CSV, row-fix, PUT). The matter update is scoped by {id, merchant_id}, so another store's stop correctly returns 404. merchant_access gives 403 to other stores. The email HTML escapes matter_ref. ZIP filename sanitizing uses [^\w-]+ -> '_'.
MatterTag: the Pressable/TextInput are nested inside the outer Pressable row. On web the TextInput does not claim the responder, so the parent press fires (root cause of UI bug 1).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (matter save/clear/cancel/receipts/search/gating OK; input-tap navigation bug, stale receipts card)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TSMR* stops on mer-1 and TEST_ law stores (removed). mer-1 was temporarily law_office and is restored to store/signature_required:false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported for test_receipt_archive_linkpages.py. test_matter_reference.py loads frontend/.env itself. The driver deliver API may 403 'Accept the privacy & compliance terms' after admin/reset. For UI seeding, set status/pod_signature/delivered_at directly in the DB. The UI repro needs mer-1 as law_office: PUT /api/admin/merchants/mer-1/settings {business_type:'law_office'}, then restore it.
rca_of_issue: UI bug 1: the order row is a Pressable(onPress=router.push). MatterTag's editing View/TextInput do not become the responder on react-native-web, so the press bubbles to the row. Repro: law_office store -> tap '+ MATTER / FILE NO.' -> tap the input -> navigates. Mitigation: onStartShouldSetResponder={() => true} on the MatterTag container, or render MatterTag outside the row Pressable.
